glosses: To attract and delight, to charm.

examples.text: New Jersey was reeling on Wednesday from the impact of Hurricane Sandy, which has caused catastrophic flooding here in Hoboken and in other New York City suburbs, destroyed entire neighborhoods across the state and wiped out iconic boardwalks in shore towns that had enchanted generations of vacationgoers.

glosses: To cast a spell upon (often one that attracts or charms).

examples.text: With the aid of his eponymous pipes, a satyr is capable of weaving a wide variety of melodic spells designed to enchant others and bring them in line with his capricious desires.

glosses: Emplir d’un vif plaisir, d’une grande admiration.
